name: @forest/e2e
description: Forest end to end: two people from two seeds, each with a stamp from the loop's verifier kept on their device and asked back by its stamp number, a profile record carrying a real stamp proof and signed pay { solana, evm }, credits bought for USDC, and the reference signer acting by the rules in each profile's folder; each person's AI logging in through the connect page and posting, messaging, reading and paying through the mcp, one request waiting for the person's yes; a deal paid directly and through an escrow, version 4, on the market's schedule, both through the fee payer; two reviews naming their evidence, one filled in by the signer and one written by the app; the loop's index counting it all and serving what each profile shows, its ratings, trust, uniqueness and pickiness, signed; and the tutor carrying its trust to a second profile with a reputation proof. The loop's own verifier, index and mcp, with the host and fee payer on loopback from this repo by default, or the deployed ones a services.json names; the chain is remote.
